default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win19cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win19cis_rule_2_3_7_4 }}
registry:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\LegalNoticeText:
    title: "2.3.7.4 | Configure 'Interactive logon: Message text for users attempting to log on' | LegalNoticeText"
    exists: true
    value:
      match-regexp: '{{ .Vars.win19cis_legal_notice_match }}'
    type: REG_SZ
    meta:
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.3.7.4
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-8
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.7.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.7/cis_2.3.7.4.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Manual: the Ansible role applies this only under conditions we cannot translate into a check, so it is shown as the original Ansible and goss test.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.4 | PATCH | Configure Interactive logon Message text for users attempting to log on"
  when: win19cis_rule_2_3_7_4
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_2.3.7.4
    - patch
    - logon
    - NIST800-171_3.1.9
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-8
  community.windows.win_security_policy:
    section: Registry Values
    key: MACHINE\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\LegalNoticeText # pragma: allowlist secret
    value: >-
      {{ '7,' ~ (win19cis_legal_notice.splitlines() | map('trim') | reject('equalto', '') | map('replace', ',', '","') | join(',')) }}
